    Constrained Kalman Filter for Linear State-Space Models

    kalman_filter.Rd

    Implements a Kalman filter for the estimation of latent states in a linear system. This implementation supports exogenous components, missing values (NA), non-negativity constraints on latent factors, and potential quadratic reconciliation.

    kalman_filter(
  Y_t,
  nu_t,
  H,
  N,
  mu_t,
  G,
  M,
  Sigma_0,
  rho_0,
  indic_pos = 0,
  Rfunction = calc_covariance,
  Qfunction = calc_covariance,
  reconciliationf = function(x, opt) {
     x
 }
)

    Arguments

    Y_t

    Matrix. Observed data matrix of dimension \(T \times ny\).

    nu_t

    Matrix. Transition equation intercept/exogenous component (\(T \times nr\)). Depends on past information only.

    H

    Matrix. Transition matrix describing the evolution of the state (e.g., AR(1) coefficients).

    N

    Matrix. State noise scaling matrix (process noise).

    mu_t

    Matrix. Measurement intercept matrix (\(T \times ny\)). Would be 0 if data is demeaned.

    G

    Matrix. Observation matrix containing the relations between observed and unobserved variables.

    M

    Matrix. Measurement noise scaling matrix.

    Sigma_0

    Matrix. Initial covariance matrix guess for the state vector.

    rho_0

    Vector. Starting guess for the initial state vector.

    indic_pos

    Vector. Binary indicators (0/1) specifying if specific latent factors must be constrained to be \(\ge 0\).

    Rfunction

    Function. Defines the measurement noise covariance. Defaults to calc_covariance.

    Qfunction

    Function. Defines the transition noise covariance. Defaults to calc_covariance.

    reconciliationf

    Function. Define a modification for rho_tt (e.g., for consistency in Augmented State Vectors in Quadratic Kalman Filters).

    Value

    A list containing:

    r

    Filtered variables \(\rho_{t|t}\) (size \(T \times nr\)).

    Sigma_tt

    Filtered state covariance \(\Sigma_{t|t}\) stored as flattened vectors.

    loglik

    Scalar. Total log-likelihood of the model.

    y_tp1_t

    Forecasted observables \(y_{t|t-1}\).

    S_tp1_t

    Predicted state covariance \(\Sigma_{t|t-1}\).

    r_tp1_t

    Predicted state vector \(\rho_{t|t-1}\).

    loglik.vector

    Vector of date-specific log-likelihoods.

    Omega_tp1_t

    Innovation covariance \(\Omega_{t|t-1}\).

    M

    The measurement scaling matrix used.

    fitted_obs

    Estimated observables given filtered states (\(\hat{y}_t|t\)).

    Note

    If reconciliationf is provided, rho_tt is modified to ensure consistency defined by the function (used in QKF for augmented state vectors).

    System Equations

    Measurement equations: $$y_t = \mu_t + G \rho_t + M \epsilon_t$$ Transition equations: $$\rho_t = \nu_t + H \rho_{t-1} + N \xi_t$$
